SELECT 
    gad.SEC_CODE AS `股票代码`, 
    gad.SEC_SNAME AS `股票简称`, 
    srdt.RPT_DATE AS `报告日期`, 
    ROUND(srdt.RD_SUM/100000000, 3) AS `研发投入总额（亿元）`
FROM 
    GET_A_SEC_CODE gad
INNER JOIN 
    STK_RD_DTL srdt ON gad.COMCODE = srdt.COMCODE
WHERE 
    gad.SEC_SNAME LIKE '%海康威视%'
    AND gad.ISVALID = 1
    AND srdt.ISVALID = 1
    AND srdt.RPT_DATE = '2025-12-31'
ORDER BY 
    srdt.RPT_DATE DESC
LIMIT 1
